edge_sample.source_text: definition Counterclockwise rotation by a right angle: The map $R : (x, y) \mapsto (-y, x)$ is a $90^\circ$ counterclockwise rotation, and preserves squared length.
edge_sample.target_text: definition Half-space to the left of a directed edge: Given distinct points $p_1, p_2 \in \mathbb{Q}^2$, the half-space strictly (resp.\ weakly) to the left of the directed segment $p_1 \to p_2$ uses basepoint $p_1$ and normal $R(p_2 - p_1)$.
